title: Global sections of a constant etale sheaf on a connected scheme
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is connected (in particular nonempty) [def-weil-connected-scheme], let $E$ be an abelian group, and let $\underline E$ be the constant sheaf with value $E$ on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto E$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], an object of $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; write $\iota_T:E\to\underline E(T)$ for the component at the final object $T$ of the canonical map from the constant presheaf to its sheafification. Then $\iota_T$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups: every global section of $\underline E$ is the constant section of a unique $e\in E$.

source.place: Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Remark (Tag 03P5, label etale-cohomology-remark-constant-locally-constant-maps): on the small etale site the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value a group G has Gamma(U, G) = the Zariski locally constant maps U -> G (the Zariski sheafification is representable by the constant group scheme G_S, Groupoids Example Tag 03YW, and representable presheaves are etale (fpqc) sheaves, Lemma Tag 03O3); a locally constant map on a connected space is constant

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-sections-locally-constant], the canonical map $\iota_T:E\to\underline E(T)$ identifies $\underline E(T)$ with the abelian group of Zariski locally constant maps $|T|\to E$, and $\iota_T(e)$ corresponds to the constant map with value $e$.

source.place: Remark 03P5 (Tag 03P5), the identification of sections of the constant sheaf with Zariski locally constant maps.

proof.text: The underlying space $|T|$ is nonempty and connected by hypothesis. Hence every locally constant map $|T|\to E$ is constant by [lem-weil-pbc-connected-locally-constant-map] (the fibres of a locally constant map are clopen, so connectedness leaves only one nonempty fibre).

source.place: Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5), with the connected-space conclusion obtained directly from the clopen fibres and [def-weil-connected-scheme].

proof.text: Under the identification of Step 1, $\iota_T$ is the map sending $e$ to the constant map with value $e$. Step 2 gives surjectivity. Since $|T|$ is nonempty, two constant maps are equal only when their values are equal, so $\iota_T$ is injective. Pointwise addition of locally constant maps makes this identification a homomorphism of abelian groups; therefore $\iota_T$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5): a locally constant map on a connected nonempty space is the unique constant map determined by any point.
